sn35.159:1.1: Rūpe bhikkhave yoniso manasi karotha || rūpāniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha || ||
sn35.159:1.2: Rūpe bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto rūpāniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto rūpesu pi nibbindati ||
sn35.159:1.10: Dhamme bhikkhave yoniso manasi karotha || dhammāniccataṃ ca yathābhutaṃ samanupassatha || ||
sn35.159:1.11: Dhamme bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto dhammāniccataṃ ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto dhammesu pi nibbindati ||
